review_locator: PMCID:PMC3406950, DUSPs, to MAP kinases and beyond
primary_title: Dual-specificity phosphatase 5 (DUSP5) as a direct transcriptional target of tumor suppressor p53
decision_basis: Direct primary ChIP, promoter-reporter, p53-status and DNA-damage evidence supports TP53/p53-dependent DUSP5 transcription; downstream ERK dephosphorylation provides bounded functional context.
limitations_preserved: Preserve wild-type versus mutant/null TP53, DNA-damage and DUSP5-ERK negative-feedback context; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.
